pick.headline: Air India Flight 182 destroyed by a bomb off Ireland
pick.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of June 24, 1985, carried Dhaka Domestic Service in English: President Ershad expressed shock and grief to Rajiv Gandhi at the Air India jumbo crash in the Atlantic; no bomb is mentioned.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 121, 24 June 1985
evidence.snippet: …fected people. President Expresses Grief Over Indian Plane Crash BK 240148 Dhaka Domestic Service in English 0110 GMT 24 Jun 85 [Text] President Ershad has expressed deep shock and grief at the heavy loss of life in the Air India jumbo jet crash in the Atlantic In a message to the Indian prime minister, Mr Rajiv Gandhi, the president said we are deeply shocked and grieved at the tragic {words indistinct] of the crash.
